items.title: Après London positions itself as a hybrid studio for everyday athletes
items.summary: The studio's official site presents coached, scalable hybrid training in Deptford — built around strength, conditioning, competition prep and community.
items.take: This is the clearest version of the offer: progressive training people can actually keep showing up to.

items.title: Amazon HYROX London returns to ExCeL on 2–6 December
items.summary: The official event page confirms a five-day London race at ExCeL, including Elite15 and Challenger15 racing on 3–4 December.
items.take: For Après-ers, the useful move is picking the right division and building backwards — not collecting a start line and hoping.

items.title: The official HYROX Gym Finder is the safest route for club listings
items.summary: HYROX's training finder is the official directory for gym affiliation and class discovery. Après London's own site remains the source for timetable, memberships and booking.
items.take: The official directory handles discovery; Après London's own site handles the timetable, memberships and booking.

items.title: The Après London channel is the verified video home
items.summary: The public YouTube handle resolves to Après London, making it the correct destination for studio videos and race-weekend content.
items.take: This is where a form library and studio content can live without scattering links across profiles.
